item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil ba rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las zor las gnam lcags thog mda'
item.coloph: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma yis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis bka' rgya thub par legs bsdom nas/ slar yang sa rta grogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag btab ste g.yung drung dbang la babs/ bstan pa'i bon 'di nyi zer ci bzhin du/ dar zhing rgyas nas bstan pa dar bar shog/
